DWAgent with server-controlled installation names

Installer: DWAgent-server-names-x64.exe
Defaults: main dwagent.exe; service executable dwagsvc.exe; service name/display name DWAgent.
Custom identity: received only after successful HTTPS server-password verification, with an explicit include_install_identity request.
Local recovery, local-only verification, and legacy positive responses select DWAgent defaults.
Wrong passwords remain rejected by the original installer. Patching the local check alone does not fetch a server profile.
Existing directories and services are not overwritten by the new installation flow.
Publisher metadata: DWService.
Portal source update: portal-server-names-update.zip. Not deployed to the live server.
An administrator must save the desired names in the updated portal before new installations receive them.
Known names can be copied manually; this is not ownership protection or a server enrollment system.

Verification:
- Installer Python regression and identity tests: 59 passed.
- Portal Python regression, authorization, and identity tests: 45 passed.
- Native registration and property parser test: passed without creating a service.
- Isolated HKCU metadata test: passed; temporary key removed by the test.
- 7-Zip integrity and extraction of both the final installer and bundled runtime: passed.
- Packaged auth/setup sources match the current project files and parse as Python 3.8.
- Packaged service binary matches the newly compiled source output.
- Extracted payload/runtime contain neither old security-service names nor example portal process names.
- The live agent was not installed, stopped, renamed, or removed.

Native output is isolated in make/tmp/server-identity/native; existing make/native binaries were preserved.
Build:
python make/package_windows_installer.py --stub make/tmp/server-identity/installer-stub-x64.exe --runtime-archive installer_payload_20260926221211/stage/runtimepy3.7z --runtime-license installer_payload_20260926221211/stage/LICENSES/runtime --sevenzip C:/Users/HP/scoop/shims/7z.exe --native-dir make/tmp/server-identity/native --install-config os_win_installer/install.json --output dist/DWAgent-server-names-x64.exe

SHA256: cfdf4caa413652b135184f7bd07451413917528102448e3103458c7f50a04460
